card.fires_on: The word "are" in the antidepressant suicidality warning, in the phrase "Patients of all ages who are started on antidepressant therapy". It appears in one repeated label passage.

modes.label: Repeated warning sentence
modes.description: The word "are" after "Patients of all ages who" in the antidepressant suicide-risk warning.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are about borders and code, so this looks unrelated to the text; no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on one word in a repeated antidepressant warning sentence, and the effect on the output is not meaningful.
